facts.text: The hotel overlooks Green Park.
facts.excerpt: This iconic Park Lane hotel in London overlooks Green Park

facts.text: Buckingham Palace and Westminster are a short stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: with Buckingham Palace and Westminster just a short stroll away

facts.text: Green Park Underground Station is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Green Park Underground Station is just a 5-minute walk away

facts.text: The hotel made its debut in the 1920s.
facts.excerpt: Since its glamorous debut in the 1920s, Sheraton Grand London Park Lane has embodied the elegance and grandeur of Mayfair

facts.text: The entire hotel is a Grade II listed building, notably the Silver Gallery, the Ballroom, the Oak Room and the Palm Court.
facts.excerpt: The entire hotel is classified as a Grade II listed building, of particular note is The Silver Gallery, the Ballroom, the Oak Room and the Palm Court.

facts.text: It is the only hotel in London with an intact full-size Art Deco, Grade II listed ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Sheraton Grand London Park Lane is the only hotel in London to boast an intact full-size art deco and Grade II listed ballroom

facts.text: The Palm Court keeps its 1920s Art Deco details, including a stained-glass ceiling, a marble floor and the original bar.
facts.excerpt: The Palm Court retains its 1920s heritage with elegant Art Deco details, including a stunning stained-glass ceiling, marble floor, and original bar

facts.text: Guests can reserve rooms with views of Green Park.
facts.excerpt: Reserve our Park Lane hotel rooms for views of Green Park and a distinguished Mayfair location.

facts.text: Rooms have bathrobes, slippers and spacious wet rooms with Sheraton-branded toiletries.
facts.excerpt: Bathrobes, slippers and spacious wet rooms with Sheraton-branded toiletries add to the experience.

facts.text: The suites have Art Deco interiors.
facts.excerpt: Boasting beautiful art décor interiors, our suites take you back to an era of timeless elegance and class.

facts.text: The Grand Park View Suite has a view of the Royal Parks.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Park View Suite is a prime location for a view of the Royal Parks.

facts.text: Club Rooms are on the higher levels of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Our glamourous Club Rooms are located on the higher levels of the hotel

facts.text: All Club Rooms and Suites include access to the Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: All Club Rooms & Suites include exclusive access to the Club Lounge.

facts.text: The Sheraton Club Lounge serves a hot buffet breakfast plus beverages, snacks and canapes throughout the day.
facts.excerpt: with a hot buffet breakfast plus beverages, snacks and canapés served throughout the day

facts.text: Suites have Penhaligon's amenities.
facts.excerpt: with Penhaligon's amenities in Suites

facts.text: The concierge team are members of Les Clefs d'Or.
facts.excerpt: Connect with our Concierge team, members of Les Clefs d’Or, for tips on what to eat, see and do.

facts.text: The hotel's Pawsome Staycation for dogs includes a dog bed, bowls, a complimentary dogtail in the Smith & Whistle bar and an in-room dog's day out in London itinerary.
facts.excerpt: includes dog bed, bowls, a complimentary dogtail in Smith & Whistle bar, In-room ‘Perfect Dog’s day out in London’ itinerary

facts.text: The London Kids' Afternoon Tea includes playful pastries of the London Eye, a London red bus and Big Ben.
facts.excerpt: The Afternoon Tea includes playful pastries of the London Eye, London Red Bus and Big Ben

facts.text: There is no on-site parking; discounted parking is available nearby.
facts.excerpt: No on-site parking. Discounted nearby parking available.

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Sheraton Grand London Park Lane do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Mercante brings a fresh take on the classic Italian food market to Mayfair.
facts.excerpt: Mercante brings a fresh take on the classic Italian food market to Mayfair.
